programs.ielts: Academic: overall 7.0, with Reading 6.5, Listening 6.5, Writing 7.0, Speaking 6.5
programs.toefl: iBT taken before 21 Jan 2026: at least 100 overall with 23+ in each section. Taken on or after 21 Jan 2026 (new scale): overall 5.0 with 4.5 in each of Speaking and Writing.

programs.deadline: 15 January 2027 for the cohort starting October 2027. Upgraded this pass from an inferred recurring date to a confirmed standing policy: the official BGSE apply page states "The application deadline for the program starting in October is January 15 of the same year." No cut-off time or timezone is published. Incomplete applications (including missing reference letters) are not considered. Applications open in mid-November each year.

From year two, teaching/research assistantships may add up to EUR 600/month on top of the grant; dissertation-phase students are often offered project employment contracts (ECONtribute, CRC). Travel funds for accepted conference papers; the grant continues for up to six months during EDP/partner-university visits. No separate scholarship application is needed.

Selected applicants may get a 15-minute Zoom interview. APS certificate required for enrolment if the most recent degree is from China, India or Vietnam. Application fee and semester contribution are not stated on any of the four pages checked.
